Physical and engineering constraints on Civilization Operating Intelligence.

Centralization risks catastrophic failure. Sectors have incompatible data and authority. Autonomy preservation is hard to guarantee.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 1.3 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is coordinated vs pilot cities at 1.3 orders of magnitude (pilot cities larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
